name: SaveTableAsFormula
formula: =LAMBDA(array,"=VSTACK(" & TEXTJOIN(",", TRUE, BYROW(array, LAMBDA(row, LET(rowWithSemiColon, BYCOL(row, LAMBDA(col, IF(ISNUMBER(col), col, CHAR(34) & col & CHAR(34)))), "HSTACK(" & TEXTJOIN(",", TRUE, rowWithSemiColon) & ")")))) & ")")
comment: To store a data table as a lambda function. output a formula for the lambda function.
